items.source:
Atomically transfer a key from a source Redis instance to a destination Redis instance. On success the key is
deleted from the original instance and is guaranteed to exist in the target instance.
items.translation: 原子地将键从源 Redis 实例传输到目标 Redis 实例。若操作成功，该键将从原始实例中删除，并保证存在于目标实例中。

channels - channel names, must not be null.

items.source: options - the options containing range, consumer and count. Must not be null.
items.translation: options - 包含范围、消费者和计数的选项。不能为 null。

items.source:
Subscribes the connection to all channels matching the given patterns. Once subscribed, a connection enters
listening mode and can only subscribe to other channels or unsubscribe. No other commands are accepted until the
connection is unsubscribed.
items.translation: 将连接订阅到所有匹配给定模式的频道。一旦订阅成功，连接即进入监听模式，此时只能订阅其他频道或取消订阅，在取消订阅之前不接受任何其他命令。

subscribe to other channels or unsubscribe. No other commands are accepted until the connection is unsubscribed.
items.translation: 将连接订阅到指定的频道。一旦订阅成功，连接即进入监听模式，此时仅可订阅其他频道或取消订阅，在取消订阅之前不接受任何其他命令。

items.source:
XDELEX is an extension of the Redis Streams XDEL command that provides more control over how message entries
are deleted concerning consumer groups.
items.translation: XDELEX 是 Redis Streams XDEL 命令的扩展，它提供了对消息条目删除方式的更多控制，特别是在涉及消费者组时。

items.source:
XACKDEL combines the functionality of XACK and XDEL in Redis Streams. It acknowledges the specified entry IDs in the
given consumer group and simultaneously attempts to delete the corresponding entries from the stream.
items.translation: XACKDEL 结合了 Redis Streams 中 XACK 和 XDEL 的功能。它会在指定的消费者组中确认给定的条目 ID，并尝试同时从流中删除相应的条目。

items.source:

Use Limit.unlimited() to read all records.

从存储在该键的流中检索特定范围内的记录的有限数量。
使用Range.unbounded()从最小和最大可能的 ID 处读取。
使用Limit.unlimited()读取所有记录。

items.source:
Executes all queued commands in a transaction started with RedisTxCommands.multi().
If used along with RedisTxCommands.watch(byte[]...) the operation will fail if any of watched keys has been modified.
items.translation:
执行由 RedisTxCommands.multi() 启动的事务中的所有排队命令。
如果与 RedisTxCommands.watch(byte[]...) 一起使用，则当任何被监视的键被修改时，该操作将失败。

items.source:
Mark the start of a transaction block.
Commands will be queued and can then be executed by calling RedisTxCommands.exec() or rolled back using RedisTxCommands.discard()
items.translation:
标记事务块的开始。
命令将被排队，随后可以通过调用RedisTxCommands.exec()执行，或使用RedisTxCommands.discard()回滚。

items.source: Returns the length of the value associated with field in the hash stored at key. If the key or the field do not exist, 0 is returned.

items.source: Get and delete the value of one or more fields from hash at key. Values are returned in the order of the requested keys. Absent field values are represented using null in the resulting List. When the last field is deleted, the key will also be deleted.
items.translation: 获取并删除哈希中指定 key 的一个或多个 fields 的值。返回值的顺序与请求的键的顺序一致。结果中的缺失字段值将用 null 表示，对应于 List。当最后一个字段被删除时，该键也将被删除。

until EXEC or DISCARD commands are issued. Since in queueing no results are returned, the connection will return

items.source: a List holding the command result for each field in order - 2 indicating the specific field is deleted already due to expiration, or provided expiry interval is 0; 1 indicating expiration time is set/updated; 0 indicating the expiration time is not set (a provided NX | XX | GT | LT condition is not met); -2 indicating there is no such field;
items.translation: 一个 `List` 按顺序持有每个字段的命令结果：2 表示该特定字段已因过期而被删除，或提供的过期间隔为 0；1 表示设置了/更新了过期时间；0 表示未设置过期时间（即提供的 NX | XX | GT | LT 条件未满足）；-2 表示该字段不存在。

items.source: a list of Long values for each of the fields provided: the time to live in the TimeUnit provided; or a negative value to signal an error. The command returns -1 if the key exists but has no associated expiration time. The command returns -2 if the key does not exist; null when used in pipeline / transaction.
items.translation: 为每个提供的字段提供一组Long值：在提供的TimeUnit中的生存时间；或一个负值以表示错误。如果键存在但没有关联的过期时间，该命令返回-1；如果键不存在，则返回-2；若在管道/事务中使用，则返回 null。

items.source: Activates the pipeline mode for this connection. When pipelined, all commands return null (the reply is read at the end through RedisConnection.closePipeline(). Calling this method when the connection is already pipelined has no effect. Pipelining is used for issuing commands without requesting the response right away but rather at the end of the batch. While somewhat similar to MULTI, pipelining does not guarantee atomicity - it only tries to improve performance when issuing a lot of commands (such as in batching scenarios).
items.translation: 启用此连接的管道模式。当处于管道模式时，所有命令均返回 null（回复将在最后通过RedisConnection.closePipeline()读取）。如果连接已经处于管道模式，调用此方法将不会产生任何效果。 管道模式用于在不需要立即获取响应，而是在批次结束时统一获取响应的情况下发送命令。虽然管道模式与 MULTI 有些相似，但它并不保证原子性——它仅在批量发送大量命令（例如在批处理场景中）时尝试提升性能。
